title: run skill does not verify build compiles before tagging candidate
description: During run 004c6afb-9d83-474f-bc34-1046fffa1cfd (signal a1000094), the Verify phase completed and a candidate tag was created without ever running `cargo build` or equivalent. The implemented code contained a compile error (`spec_path_arg` used in scope where only `resolved_spec_path` exists). The error was only discovered post-run when the user attempted to use the build. The spec.skill.md Verify phase checks rubric adherence but has no step that actually compiles the project.
proposed_resolution:
Add a structural build criterion to `.moeb/rubrics/project.rubrics.md` (phase: 'structural'). The criterion must define the build command generically via a configurable `build_command` field or project-supplied shell snippet so the skill remains language-agnostic. The build command is run; a non-zero exit code or any compiler error output constitutes a failure.

Once a1000099 (rubric phased execution framework) is resolved, add a `skill_ref` pointing to a rubric skill block that attempts to fix compile errors inline (read build error output → identify failing line → apply targeted patch_file fix → re-run build check). Until a1000099 is resolved, the criterion operates as `signal_only`: build failure emits a signal and fails the QA gate without inline fix attempt.
